fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Admin API access token of a custom app installed on the store (Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps), with read_products/write_products scopes; sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token.

config_fields.name: shop
config_fields.help: The store's myshopify subdomain (the part before .myshopify.com).

adapter.terms: The REST Admin API is legacy for new public apps (GraphQL required since 2025-04-01); custom apps may use it. Rate limit: 2 requests/s (leaky bucket of 40) on standard plans.

me.note: GET /shop.json: the store's name, domain, plan, currency.

body.query: =query ListProducts($first: Int!, $after: String, $query: String) { products(first: $first, after: $after, query: $query) { nodes { id legacyResourceId title handle status updatedAt onlineStoreUrl } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

list_items.note: GraphQL Admin products(first, after, query) (the REST list paginates with a Link header): items are products; id is the numeric product id used by get/update/delete, query uses Shopify search syntax (e.g. title:shirt status:active). Pass next_cursor back as cursor; on the last page the cursor returns no items (hasNextPage is in raw only on the page).

get_item.note: GET /products/{id}.json: one product with variants, options and images in raw.

create_item.note: POST /products.json {product: {title, body_html, …fields}}: fields may add vendor, product_type, tags, status (active|draft|archived), variants, images … as documented.

update_item.note: PUT /products/{id}.json {product: {title, body_html, …fields}}: only the given properties change.

not_offered.generate_image: The Admin API has no image generation endpoint.
not_offered.generate_video: The Admin API has no video generation endpoint.
not_offered.get_job: No generation jobs in the Admin API.

evidence: host graphql.myshopify.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: list_items:variables
